prompt_md: Ten bags hold plenty of coins. Real coins weigh 10 g, but one bag is all fakes at 9 g each. With an exact digital scale, how few weighings find the fake bag?
prompt_short: 10 bags, one all 9 g fakes, digital scale. Fewest weighings?
hint_md: Take a different number of coins from each bag.
explain_intuition_md: Splitting the bags in halves takes about four weighings. Instead, take 1 coin from bag 1, 2 from bag 2, and so on up to 10 from bag 10, and weigh them all together. The total falls short of 550 g by exactly the number of the fake bag.
